stem:
The diagram shows Dhruv shining a torch at three sheets X, Y and Z. Through X almost all the light passes and shapes look clear. Through Y only some light passes and shapes look unclear. Through Z no light passes.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Y is translucent because only some light passes and shapes look unclear.
Y is transparent because some light passes through it.
Y is opaque because shapes look unclear.
X is translucent because almost all the light passes through it.

teacher.key_rationale: Partial light with unclear shapes means translucent. Calling Y transparent or opaque, or calling clear full-pass X translucent, misclassifies the light evidence.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source glass figure into torch through sheets X, Y, Z.
